def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validation
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
    n_cand, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != logp_with_result.shape or logp_no_call.shape != logp_with_result.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if n_cand == 0 or future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    # Compute sums over horizon
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call_only = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no_call = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Margin from including the result
    margin = sum_with - sum_no_call
    # Margin from call only
    margin_call_only = sum_call_only - sum_no_call
    # Keep if the result improves significantly above threshold
    # and the call without result does not improve above threshold
    keep = (margin > tau_filter) & (margin_call_only < tau_filter)
    return keep, margin
